title: Record why a native Claude dispatch fell back to claude-agent
read_first: packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/drivers/prepare.rs (claude_session_candidate ~2509, claude_sessions_enabled ~729, the claude-agent branch ~2981, dispatch record native_fallback_reason ~3224, envelope fallback_reason ~3269, tests ~6830-6990)
action: Outcome: on runtime claude, when the resolved route is a native model (Resolved::Model with a non-empty model) but prepare returns channel claude-agent, the .bee/logs/dispatch.jsonl record carries native_fallback_reason naming the cause: escalated (is_escalated), claude_sessions_off (dispatch.claude_sessions false or sessions not armed), or claude_cli_missing (existing). The envelope fallback_reason follows the same value. A dispatch that never had a native model gets no reason. Contract: channel choice unchanged; existing claude_cli_missing behavior unchanged; no code comments.
must_haves: red-first test: an escalated native-model claude dispatch logs native_fallback_reason escalated
red-first test: dispatch.claude_sessions false logs native_fallback_reason claude_sessions_off
existing tests that assert no fallback_reason on claude-session and herding channels stay green
acceptance: A claude-agent fallback in dispatch.jsonl always says why.

deviations: an escalated dispatch lands on channel session-model, not claude-agent; it still gets native_fallback_reason escalated
trace.verification_evidence: change confined to prepare.rs and its in-file tests

mistakes.wrong: cell pvs-2 premise said an escalated dispatch lands on channel claude-agent
mistakes.better: the leader should have read the escalation branch before writing the cell
